# Protocol fidelity summary
#
# What each response document loses when it round-trips through its Go type.
# Regenerate with: go test ./internal/gmptest -run TestFidelitySummary -update
#
# 'dropped' is the count of distinct paths no Go field captures; a dropped
# parent folds its descendants, so one line can stand for a whole subtree.
# 'changed' is a path that survived carrying a different value, e.g. a GMP
# boolean '1' re-emitted as 'true'. Structural retention is not fidelity.
# 'added' is elements the round trip invents (non-pointer fields without
# omitempty, zero time.Time) and is not loss.

fixtures: 338   clean: 195   with-loss: 132   decode-errors: 10   advisory: 1
commands with loss: 37 of 122
distinct dropped paths: 166
